representation: last hidden layer; arithmetic mean over residue tokens only; append amidation flag; encoder frozen

cv.method: StratifiedGroupKFold on the 442 candidate identities; identical folds for every arm; related sequences and amidation variants share group IDs

fit_scope: Original arm fits only original-ready rows in each training fold; expanded arms fit all training-fold rows. All arms score the same 442 validation identities.
preprocessing: StandardScaler fit inside each fold; no PCA; L2 lbfgs logistic regression with max_iter 5000; no class weights
selection: Embedding C selected by mean fold balanced accuracy; ties favor smaller C; fixed charge C=0.1

bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of pooled out-of-fold metrics and paired differences

limitations: Selected development scores are conditional on tuning and reused training data; not unbiased final test estimates.
The evaluated v1 test and clinical sets are not used to select a v2 model.
Pretraining overlap with published proteins/peptides is not audited.
A new independent evaluation is required before claiming improved final performance.
